    quote: "{\n  \"extraction_method\": \"geometric_sort\",\n  \"has_extracted_text\": true,\n  \"page_rect\": [\n    0.0,\n    0.0,\n    595.219970703125,\n    842.0\n  ],\n  \"pdf_page\": 95,\n  \"review_status\": \"pending_manual_review\",\n  \"rotation\": 0,\n  \"text\": \"Safety Health & Environment (SHE) Manual\\n279\\n\\n                          BANGALORE METRO RAIL CORPORATION LTD.\\n\\n\\n\\n                                APPENDIX NO.: 4\\n\\n\\n\\n        WORKPLACE POLICY ON HIV/AIDS PREVENTION & CONTROL FOR WORKMEN\\n                        ENGAGED BY CONTRACTORS\\n\\n             “Being mobile in and of itself is not a risk factor for HIV infection.  It is the situations\\n           encountered and the behaviours possibly engaged in during mobility or migration that\\n                           increase vulnerability and risk regarding HIV / AIDS.”\\n\\n               UNAIDS, Technical update on ‘Population, Mobility and AIDS’, February 2001, p.5\\n\\n        Bangalore Metro Rail Corporation (BMRC) recognizes HIV  / AIDS as a developmental\\n         challenge and realizes the need to respond to  it by implementing regular HIV  / AIDS\\n         prevention programmes and  creating a  non-discriminatory work environment  for HIV\\n          infected workmen engaged by contractors.  For the purpose of making conscientious,\\n          sensitive and compassionate decision in addressing the realities of HIV / AIDS, DMRC has\\n         established these guidelines based on ILO code of practice on HIV / AIDS.\\n\\n                Creating awareness through professional agency using IEC (Information, Education\\n             and Communication) package specially designed for migrant workers.\\n\\n                   Institutional capacity building by training the project implementation team, Safety,\\n               Health & Environment (SHE) Managers, establishing linkages for efficient diagnosis\\n             and treatment of the affected workers, effective monitoring of implementation and\\n               documentation for further learning.\\n\\n                 Establishing peer educators by selecting them in consultation with contractors and\\n                  training them through professional agencies so that they become focal point for any\\n                 information, education and awareness campaigns among the workmen throughout\\n                the contract period.\\n\\n               Promotion of social marketing of condoms through State Aids Control Society.\\n\\n\\n\\n\\n\\n         Bangalore Metro Rail Corporation Ltd.     quote: "{\n  \"pdf_page\": 107,\n  \"text\": \"BANGALORE METRO RAIL CORPORATION LTD.\\n\\n\\n\\n                            General Instruction: BMRC/SHE/CEO/009\\n\\n\\n\\n         Minimum Requirements of SHE Communication Posters / Signages / Video\\n\\n\\n          1. Every contractor falling into the above groups shall prepare a SHE Communication Plan as a\\n                 part of site specific SHE Plan and shall include the following minimum requirement of Posters /\\n              Signages / Video as applicable. In case readymade posters are available in any of the category\\n               from National Safety Council, Loss Prevention Association of India or any other safety related\\n                organisations they may procure the same and display it. # Safety, Health and Environment Manual – Appendices, General Instructions and Forms Overview

> Draft source synthesis. Pending PDF and human review; no compliance or applicability decision.

## Summary

Volume 3, Section I Appendices, General Instructions and Forms provides mandatory contract attachments for BMRCL Tender Package P1, including the Safety Memorandum of Understanding (Appendix 1), statutory BOCW compliance lists (Appendix 2), and general instructions. [^e1] [^e2]

Technical Volume 3 includes an appendices, general instructions, and forms section mapping statutory requirements and rule references such as BOCW and labor regulations to specific manual sections and statutory rules. [^e3] [^e4] [^e5]

## Open questions and contradictions

- The parsed column data for Appendix 2 statutory requirements exhibits unseparated item and reference columns, requiring manual review of text fragments for items 5 through 40. [^e3] [^e50] [^e51] See [[wiki/review_queue|review queue]] and [[wiki/source_quirks|source quirks]].
- Appendix 2 contains duplicate entries for medical examination for occupational health hazards, listed under both item numbers 76 and 82, which are preserved in the parsed records with their original item numbers. [^e52] See [[wiki/review_queue|review queue]] and [[wiki/source_quirks|source quirks]].
- The parsed JSON records for Appendix 3 indicate layout structures and page numbering spanning PDF pages 93 and 94 (Section pages 89 and 90 of 114 within the SHE manual). [^e28] [^e29] See [[wiki/review_queue|review queue]] and [[wiki/source_quirks|source quirks]].

## Additional source statements

- Volume 3 appendices and general instructions outline statutory compliance references, checklists, and safety management requirements for BMRCL Tender Package P1. [^e53] [^e54]
- Technical Volume 3 includes Appendix No. 2, which outlines statutory safety, welfare, and occupational health requirements under the BOCW Act 1996, BOCW Rules 1998, and BOCWKR Rules 2006, along with Appendix No. 3 providing the Site SHE Plan template. [^e25] [^e55]
- Volume 3, Section I of the BMRCL tender documentation sets out the Appendices, General Instructions, and Forms accompanying the Safety, Health and Environment (SHE) Manual for Contract Package P1. [^e28] [^e29]
- Volume 3 appendices and forms include workplace guidelines such as the HIV/AIDS Prevention and Control Policy for contractor workmen (Appendix 4) and standard administrative forms such as the Formation of Site SHE Committee (Form SF/001). [^e56] [^e35]
- The Safety, Health and Environment Manual Appendices, General Instructions and Forms contain mandatory instructions on staffing requirements based on contract value, audio-visual equipment minimum standards, accident investigation kit contents, and standard committee meeting forms. [^e40] [^e37] [^e39] [^e41] [^e38] [^e36]
- General Instruction BMRC/SHE/CEO/004 details the required topics for the first day at work SHE orientation training of workmen, covering hazard identification, personal protective equipment, health, contractor's duties, and employee's duties. [^e57]
- General Instruction BMRC/SHE/CEO/005 specifies the ID Card format (85 mm x 55mm) for BMRC Project Phase I, detailing the required front and back side information, property clause, replacement charges for loss or theft, and the return address. [^e58]
- General Instruction BMRC/SHE/CEO/006 outlines comprehensive Safety, Health and Environment (SHE) training details and topic areas specifically designed for managers and supervisors, covering law and safety, policy and administration, accident prevention, site inspection, housekeeping, health, personal protective equipment, electricity, and heavy machinery/equipment operations. [^e42]
- General Instruction BMRC/SHE/CEO/007 establishes the comprehensive SHE Training Matrix, which maps distinct safety training modules and mandatory competencies against various project roles including Project Manager, Senior Construction Managers, Quality Manager, Planning Engineer, Construction Managers, Construction Supervisors, Foremen, Operators, and various specialist trades. [^e59]
- General Instruction BMRC/SHE/CEO/008 outlines the calendar of days to be observed for creating SHE awareness throughout the contract lifecycle. [^e60]
- General Instruction BMRC/SHE/CEO/010 lists approved external experts and agencies for SHE services such as external audits, technical training, medical facilities, and ISO certification. [^e61] [^e62] [^e63] [^e64]
- The SHE Manual Appendices and General Instructions specify operational safety parameters, including lighting requirements under General Instruction BMRC/SHE/CEO/011 and warning sign standards under BMRC/SHE/CEO/012. [^e46] [^e65] [^e66]
- The Contractor is required to follow all safety guidelines, rules, regulations, and codes, and must prepare a detailed method statement incorporating a job safety analysis for any complicated, hazardous, or high-risk work, securing prior approval from the Employer before commencing execution. [^e47]

>   "text": "Safety Health & Environment (SHE) Manual\n279\n\n                          BANGALORE METRO RAIL CORPORATION LTD.\n\n\n\n                                APPENDIX NO.: 4\n\n\n\n        WORKPLACE POLICY ON HIV/AIDS PREVENTION & CONTROL FOR WORKMEN\n                        ENGAGED BY CONTRACTORS\n\n             “Being mobile in and of itself is not a risk factor for HIV infection.  It is the situations\n           encountered and the behaviours possibly engaged in during mobility or migration that\n                           increase vulnerability and risk regarding HIV / AIDS.”\n\n               UNAIDS, Technical update on ‘Population, Mobility and AIDS’, February 2001, p.5\n\n        Bangalore Metro Rail Corporation (BMRC) recognizes HIV  / AIDS as a developmental\n         challenge and realizes the need to respond to  it by implementing regular HIV  / AIDS\n         prevention programmes and  creating a  non-discriminatory work environment  for HIV\n          infected workmen engaged by contractors.  For the purpose of making conscientious,\n          sensitive and compassionate decision in addressing the realities of HIV / AIDS, DMRC has\n         established these guidelines based on ILO code of practice on HIV / AIDS.\n\n                Creating awareness through professional agency using IEC (Information, Education\n             and Communication) package specially designed for migrant workers.\n\n                   Institutional capacity building by training the project implementation team, Safety,\n               Health & Environment (SHE) Managers, establishing linkages for efficient diagnosis\n             and treatment of the affected workers, effective monitoring of implementation and\n               documentation for further learning.\n\n                 Establishing peer educators by selecting them in consultation with contractors and\n                  training them through professional agencies so that they become focal point for any\n                 information, education and awareness campaigns among the workmen throughout\n                the contract period.\n\n               Promotion of social marketing of condoms through State Aids Control Society.\n\n\n\n\n\n         Bangalore Metro Rail Corporation Ltd.              September 2026     Section Page 91 of 114",

>   "text": "BANGALORE METRO RAIL CORPORATION LTD.\n\n\n\n                            General Instruction: BMRC/SHE/CEO/009\n\n\n\n         Minimum Requirements of SHE Communication Posters / Signages / Video\n\n\n          1.     For the purpose of Minimum requirements of SHE Communication Posters  / Signages  /\n              Video the contracts are categorized into the following groups:\n\n\n                           Contract Value (Initial awarded value of contract)              Group\n\n\n                                        Upto 25 Cr                          A\n\n\n                                       Upto 100 Cr                         B\n\n\n                                       Upto 250 Cr                       C\n\n\n                                  More than 250 Cr                      D\n\n\n          2.     Every contractor falling into the above groups shall prepare a SHE Communication Plan as a\n                 part of site specific SHE Plan and shall include the following minimum requirement of Posters /\n              Signages / Video as applicable. In case readymade posters are available in any of the category\n               from National Safety Council, Loss Prevention Association of India or any other safety related\n                organisations they may procure the same and display it. In case the same is not available then\n                the contractors’ shall make necessary arrangements to get the posters designed and printed\n             on their own.\n\n\n                    All the above are to be detailed in the Site SHE Plan and get an approval from the Employer\n                before displaying the posters.\n\n\n                                  Table No.: 1 - Minimum No. of Posters\n\n\n                                   Minimum           No. of Posters / Signage / Video\n                                          No. of\n                                              Group A  Group B  Group C  Group D\n          Sl.No    SHE Poster Title      concepts\n                                                      Contract   Contract   Contract   Contract\n                                                  in each\n                                                                 title\n\n              1.    Safety Culture                5      Each 10   Each 50   Each 75   Each 100\n\n              2.    Daily Safety Oath         1 English    Each 100  Each 200  Each 500 Each 1000\n                                   &1 Hindi\n\n              3.    Mandatory PPE Usage\n\n               a)  Signages to display the    2 types of    Each 25   Each 50   Each 75   Each 200\n               messages like PPE         sizes made\n              ZONE, NO PPE ZONE,    up of metal\n            HARD HAT AREA etc.     sheet to be\n                                      mounted at\n                                                     different\n                                                 locations\n\n              b)  Helmet                     5      Each 25   Each 50   Each 75   Each 200"

### Jcb88a9688b005df4

[[OKF_bundle/Technical/Vol3/vol3_appendices_instructions_forms#Safety, Health and Environment Manual – Appendices, General Instructions and Forms|SHE vol3_appendices_instructions_forms]], `Vol3DLNP1.pdf`, PDF p. 95 (`parsed_json/vol3/appendix_4_workplace_policy/workplace_policy.json#/introduction_quote_and_attribution`)

> {

>       "pdf_page": 95,
>       "text": "BANGALORE METRO RAIL CORPORATION LTD.\n\n\n\n                                APPENDIX NO.: 4\n\n\n\n        WORKPLACE POLICY ON HIV/AIDS PREVENTION & CONTROL FOR WORKMEN\n                        ENGAGED BY CONTRACTORS\n\n             “Being mobile in and of itself is not a risk factor for HIV infection.  It is the situations\n           encountered and the behaviours possibly engaged in during mobility or migration that\n                           increase vulnerability and risk regarding HIV / AIDS.”\n\n               UNAIDS, Technical update on ‘Population, Mobility and AIDS’, February 2001, p.5\n\n        Bangalore Metro Rail Corporation (BMRC) recognizes HIV  / AIDS as a developmental\n         challenge and realizes the need to respond to  it by implementing regular HIV  / AIDS\n         prevention programmes and  creating a  non-discriminatory work environment  for HIV\n          infected workmen engaged by contractors.  For the purpose of making conscientious,\n          sensitive and compassionate decision in addressing the realities of HIV / AIDS, DMRC has\n         established these guidelines based on ILO code of practice on HIV / AIDS."

>     {
>       "pdf_page": 95,
>       "source_line_number": 20,
>       "text": ""
>     },
>     {
>       "pdf_page": 95,
>       "source_line_number": 21,
>       "text": "        Bangalore Metro Rail Corporation (BMRC) recognizes HIV  / AIDS as a developmental"
>     },
>     {
>       "pdf_page": 95,
>       "source_line_number": 22,
>       "text": "         challenge and realizes the need to respond to  it by implementing regular HIV  / AIDS"
>     },
>     {
>       "pdf_page": 95,
>       "source_line_number": 23,
>       "text": "         prevention programmes and  creating a  non-discriminatory work environment  for HIV"
>     },
>     {
>       "pdf_page": 95,
>       "source_line_number": 24,
>       "text": "          infected workmen engaged by contractors.  For the purpose of making conscientious,"
>     },
>     {
>       "pdf_page": 95,
>       "source_line_number": 25,
>       "text": "          sensitive and compassionate decision in addressing the realities of HIV / AIDS, DMRC has"
>     },
>     {
>       "pdf_page": 95,
>       "source_line_number": 26,
>       "text": "         established these guidelines based on ILO code of practice on HIV / AIDS."
>     },

>       "pdf_page": 95,

>       "text": ""

>   "text": "BANGALORE METRO RAIL CORPORATION LTD. \nGeneral Instruction: BMRC/SHE/CEO/007 \n \nSHE Training Matrix \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \nTypes of training \nManagement \nSupervisor \nIndustrial First Aid & CPR \nIncident / Accident Investigation & Reporting  \nFire fighting \nConfined Space Testing & Certification  \nScaffold Erection & Inspection \nRigging \nWire Rope
